about: The gallery shop path's standing check (scraper/gallery_shop_check.js). Fifteen high-profile galleries, English-speaking and not; each `shop` is set by her rule from the gallery's live site before the run (26 Oct 2026): the NARROWEST section that holds the catalogues and can be read — the catalogues section, else the gallery's own publications, else books, else everything; `also`: the same section at another spelling of its address; null: no shop of its own. `show`: a show page, read first as the app reads the link; none where no show page could be read (the app then starts at the home page, as Look again does). `english`: false for a gallery in a country that does not speak English.
